name: org-umbrella
description: One-command local dev orchestration for all services.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && concurrently -n backend,gxp,lims,frontend -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:gxp" "npm:dev:lims" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix gxp-service run typecheck && npm --prefix lims-service run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.prettier:check: npm --prefix backend run prettier:check && npm --prefix gxp-service run prettier:check && npm --prefix lims-service run prettier:check && npm --prefix frontend run prettier:check
scripts.db:check: npm --prefix backend run db:migrate:check && npm --prefix gxp-service run db:migrate:check && npm --prefix lims-service run db:migrate:check
